title: Stage 5.2 Subject-Aware Spatial Localization Formal Experiment (LOC-1 RT-DETR-R50 + Policy v1)

research_questions.H1: Reliable person priority (policy v1) removes category-priority errors (e.g. potted_plant/car/chair/vase/microwave over reliable person) without breaking engineering stability.
research_questions.H2: A diagnostic-only subject-box -> exact target-ratio crop transform removes the shape confounding between tight subject boxes and 9:16-style weak crop references.
research_questions.H3: RT-DETR-R50 + policy v1 keeps high detection coverage, legal bboxes, low fallback, determinism, and acceptable inference cost on a larger fixed formal subset.

rules: drop geometrically invalid candidates (non-finite, inverted, zero extent); count INVALID_GEOMETRY
no possible -> NO_DETECTION fallback; possible but no reliable -> LOW_CONFIDENCE fallback
primary = highest score in valid reliable pool; ties by area desc then input order
BOX_TOO_SMALL if area < 0.002 * frame area; BOX_TOO_LARGE if area >= 0.995 * frame area; FULL_FRAME_LIKE if width >= 98% and height >= 98% -> CENTER_CROP_FALLBACK
MULTI_SUBJECT_AMBIGUOUS flag (no fallback) when another reliable candidate within score gap 0.05 has IoU < 0.5 vs primary

policy_v1.single_change: if any reliable candidate has class == 'person', primary is selected among reliable persons only (score desc -> area desc -> input order); otherwise exact v0 behavior

crop_compatible_diagnostic.tag: DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY / not the Stage 5.3 production algorithm
crop_compatible_diagnostic.definition: subject_centered_crop: minimal integer-k crop with exact targetRatioWH ratio fully containing the primary subject, centered on subject center, shifted into frame; if the required crop exceeds the frame, degrade to the largest legal target-ratio crop (k_max = min(floor(W/tw), floor(H/th))), flagged degraded

configurations.LOC-1-v0: RT-DETR-R50 raw candidates + policy v0 (raw subject box)
configurations.LOC-1-v1: RT-DETR-R50 raw candidates + policy v1 (raw subject box)
configurations.LOC-1-v0-CROP: diagnostic transform applied to LOC-1-v0 primary
configurations.LOC-1-v1-CROP: diagnostic transform applied to LOC-1-v1 primary

shared_raw_detector: single detector pass per run feeds both policies; candidates recorded verbatim in raw_detector.json

formal_manifest.sampling_rule: sorted(video_id); strata with_weak_roi 18 + dropped_center_default 12 (model-blind, weak-reference presence only); even index spacing; up to 15 evenly spaced Stage 5.1 frozen predicted frames per video; frozen before formal inference

weak_reference.status: seed_weak_training_label_v1; NOT official GT; WEAK_REFERENCE_DIAGNOSTIC only; NOT FOR OFFICIAL SCORE CLAIM

metrics: primary-gate engineering counters (invalid bbox, crop invalid, frame identity, model errors)
policy behavior gate (reliable-person frames, v0 violations, v1 violations, changed counts)
weak-reference IoU/center-error per configuration with paired win/tie/loss (diagnostic only)

all_must_pass: diagnostic crop invalid (non-exact-ratio or out-of-bounds or overlapping-error) = 0
Stage 5.1 frozen contract regression = 0 (full pytest, allowlisted Stage 4.6 items excluded)
deterministic semantic rerun PASS (Run A vs Run B: raw candidates, v1 decisions, crop outputs identical)
unknown frame = 0 (no frame outside frozen selected set)
policy v1 does not change detector candidates (same raw_detector for v0/v1)
policy v1 only changes primary selection (no temporal, no frame set, no writer changes)

policy_behavior_gate.definition: for every frame with >= 1 reliable person candidate, policy v1 primary must be a person

determinism_note: no stochastic components; fp32 + inference_mode; semantic hashes compared across Run A/B excluding wall-time fields
next_step_gate: READY_FOR_STAGE5_2_FULL_DEV_INFERENCE only if all primary gates PASS and behavior/latency/VRAM acceptable; 51,256-frame run requires user confirmation
